name: What are the signs that I might need pipe rerouting?

mainEntity.name: What are the signs that I might need pipe rerouting?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common signs indicating a potential need for pipe rerouting include persistent leaks, discolored or rusty water, significantly reduced water pressure, or unusually high water bills without a clear explanation. Gurgling noises from drains or frequent backups can also point to issues with drain lines that may require rerouting. A practical tradeoff to consider is that addressing these symptoms proactively through rerouting can prevent more extensive and costly water damage to your property down the line.
acceptedAnswer.description: Signs include persistent leaks, discolored water, low pressure, high water bills, or gurgling drains.
